collections.title: Foundational
collections.description: The shields.io DNA. Classic splits, pills, stacks, and outlines — the building blocks every developer recognizes.

collections.title: Premium
collections.description: Depth, material and craft. Built from borders, insets, gradients and layered light — for brands that demand refinement.

collections.title: Technical
collections.description: Instrumentation, readouts and engineering notation. For tools that demand accuracy and precision.

collections.title: Luminous
collections.description: Light as structure. Readable first, radiant second. Glows, sweeps and prismatic effects.

collections.title: Brutalist
collections.description: Bold, confident, unapologetic. Neo-brutalist aesthetics with hard shadows, thick borders and raw geometry.

collections.title: Editorial
collections.description: Typography-led. Rules, margins, indices and voice. For publications and refined interfaces.

collections.title: Industrial
collections.description: Hardware, mechanical, utilitarian. Warning stripes, rivets, plates and stencils — for tools built to last.

collections.title: Organic
collections.description: Soft, fluid, natural. Asymmetric blob shapes and squircles — for interfaces that breathe.

collections.title: Terminal
collections.description: CLI aesthetics. Monospace, prompts, ANSI colors and scanlines — for developers who live in the shell.

collections.title: System
collections.description: Functional composites. Real product affordances — avatars, diffs, command palettes, keycaps, gauges and sparklines.

collections.title: Experimental
collections.description: Silhouette as identity. Hexagons, shields, notches, arrows, skewed containers and stepped silhouettes.

collections.title: Kinetic
collections.description: Time as a structural axis. Pulses, progress, spinners, marquees and sweeps — rendered as animated WebP via Vexillum.

collections.title: Data
collections.description: Metrics and charts. Gauges, sparklines, heatmaps, pies and area charts — for dashboards and landing pages.

collections.title: Social
collections.description: Community and engagement. Brand-colored pills for GitHub, Discord, YouTube, Reddit, Spotify and more.

collections.title: Status
collections.description: Indicators, dots, rings and beacons. The universal language of system health.

collections.title: Minimal
collections.description: Ultra-clean, stripped down. Typography-only badges for interfaces that whisper.

collections.title: Slab
collections.description: Borderless solid tone‑blocks, horizontal. Variants: radius, segment count, seam, fill, corner clip.

collections.title: Frame
collections.description: Heavy ink frame + recessed value well (auto‑inset via calc — cannot overflow).

collections.title: Capsule
collections.description: Borderless stadium, two coloured lobes.

collections.title: Tab
collections.description: Flush protruding tab; the full member spans the whole width as a header band (top corners from the body clip).

collections.title: Ruled
collections.description: Open sides carried by an accent rule; the marker is spaced by an explicit margin so it never touches the value text.

collections.title: Ledger
collections.description: Fixed measure; label and value joined by a leader line.

collections.title: Facet
collections.description: The seed becomes a border that follows a clipped corner. No ticks — the silhouette is the device; value uses safe inset wells / gap pips.

collections.title: Ring
collections.description: Pill body + detached outline ring (outline never clips) + inset lozenge.

collections.title: Cap
collections.description: No border: a solid colour cap holds the label, the value floats on a shadow‑only body. The trailing pipe is gone.

collections.title: Contour
collections.description: Engraved concentric inset keylines + a solid value block set inside.

collections.title: Crop
collections.description: No continuous border — four registration marks frame the type; padding always clears the mark length.

collections.title: Rail
collections.description: One rounded body + a thin inner meta strip below a hairline (≥39px so both rows breathe).

collections.title: Ticket
collections.description: Subtle 1px body border that the mask notch bites through, with a fine 1px perforation delimiter inset below each notch.

collections.title: Stack
collections.description: Vertical stat tile — micro‑caps key over a hero figure, two rows only, ≥40px.

collections.title: Float
collections.description: A pale hairline tray holding whisper‑lifted paper chips — raised, pressed (inset), outlined, solo‑dot, flexing and stacked members. No loud beds, no heavy shadows.

collections.title: Spark
collections.description: Hairline box closed by a trailing inline‑SVG trend cell — 16 distinct data geometries.

collections.title: Stacked
collections.description: Physical depth by construction: offset layers, ghost copies, rims and inset panels give badges a paper-stack presence.

collections.title: Stat
collections.description: Dashboard-grade KPIs: deltas, ranks, rates, odometers and receipt totals with tabular figures and trend semantics.
